cards.name: confirm_sale
cards.spec: confirm_sale(sale) confirms a sale and lowers stock. First check every item in sale.saleitem_set: if any item's quantity is greater than its product's stock, raise ValueError and change nothing for any product. Only if every item is available, call reduce_stock(item.product, item.quantity) for each item. reduce_stock is imported with: from products.services import reduce_stock
